svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make twelve from the flat pattern (petal pattern picture).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Leave the protective film on until the dish is finished.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut with aviation snips; drill 3 mm relief holes where folds meet.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fold a 12 mm flange down along both long edges, a little at a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: time along the length, so the petal takes up a gentle curve.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fold the two 30 mm tabs down at the outer edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lay the petal on two neighbouring ribs, flanges outside the ribs;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: drill 3.3 mm through flange and rib every 50 mm and rivet with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3.2 mm aluminium rivets; rivet each tab to the rim band.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Never scratch the bright face; handle with clean cotton gloves.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the petal edges meet over each rib with a gap of 3 to 5 mm.
